title: The Works: tier 6, The still
lines: Tier 6 is open. A still turns every 6 tar into 3 pitch, 2 creosote and 1 spirit, each out of its own part of its front. It stops while any one of them cannot leave, and the depot takes none of them.
A cracker makes 1 creosote from 2 pitch, or 1 spirit from 2 creosote. A powerhouse burns any of the three and makes 300 power.

more.head: New
points: Stills, crackers and powerhouses make smog.
Research lets a tunnel pass under 20 tiles.
